artifacts.summary: 7-phase, ~6h plan adding a source-side tier-3 cross-repo fleet freshness report: git-tracked consumer registry, new check-consumer-freshness.sh (with --discover), a guarded post-deploy stale-consumer report in deploy-headless.sh, and a non-blocking consecutive-ignore escalation on tier 1.

memory_candidates.content: Adding a NEW script under agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/ is never a one-file change in this repo: check-extension-docs.sh rule Q (check_undeclared_scripts) hard-fails on any script on disk absent from manifest.json's provides.scripts, and an operator-facing standalone script also belongs in docs/reference/utility-scripts-inventory.md. Adding a NEW ephemeral runtime file has three parallel registration surfaces: a **/.name pattern in root-files/.gitignore, a row in context/standards/orchestrator-runtime-files.md's two-class table, and a probe in check-runtime-file-tracking.sh's EPHEMERAL_PROBES (checks A/B fail otherwise). Also: manifest provides.context declares whole DIRECTORIES (e.g. 'reference'), so anything placed under context/reference/ deploys to every consumer -- 'source-repo-only metadata' is not achievable there without manifest surgery.
